Class FilterMenu

Object
FilterMenu
public class FilterMenu extends Object

  • Method Details

    • open

      public void open(FilterSettings filters, boolean allowStatus, boolean allowMajor, boolean allowLevel, boolean allowSort, boolean allowVisibility)
      Opens a reusable filter configuration menu.
      Parameters:
      filters - The FilterSettings instance (persisted per user/menu)
      allowStatus - Whether this role can filter by Internship Status
      allowMajor - Whether this role can filter by Preferred Major
      allowLevel - Whether this role can filter by Internship Level
      allowSort - Whether this role can change sorting order
      allowVisibility - Whether this role can filter by visibility (ON/OFF/ALL)
